description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Fernando Mendoza is expected to play roughly the first half in Thursday's preseason game against the Texans.
items.impact: Mendoza will get extended run on the field in his second preseason game. Aidan O'Connell will take the field in the second half.
items.title: Fernando Mendoza to play roughly first half Thursday

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Danny Pinter is expected to miss an extended period of time after suffering a knee injury in Wednesday's practice.
items.impact: Pinter had been viewed as the likely leading candidate to start at center for the Ravens this season. That will not be the case, however, at least for a long while. Pinter tore a patellar tendon during Wednesday's practice session and could possibly miss the entire season.
items.title: Danny Pinter (knee) to miss extended period of time

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Sam LaPorta is currently dealing with a hip injury, and HC Dan Campbell told reporters that the team is uncertain if it will affect his availability for Week 1.
items.impact: LaPorta injured his hip on a hit in practice recently. The team is uncertain about the severity of it at this point and will be giving him a few days off to rest and recover before reevaluating. Fantasy managers should pay close attention to this situation, as he may not be worth drafting at his current ADP if he has to miss one or more games at the start of the regular season.
items.title: Sam LaPorta suffers hip injury, uncertain for Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Khalil Shakir was not seen at Thursday's joint practice.
items.impact: It is unclear what Shakir is dealing with specifically. There should be an update on his status from head coach Joe Brady soon.
items.title: Khalil Shakir not practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kyler Murray will not play in Saturday's preseason game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Murray was officially named the Week 1 starter last week. J.J. McCarthy will "more than likely" start Saturday's preseason game.
items.title: Kyler Murray will not play Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said J.J. McCarthy is "more than likely" to start Saturday's preseason game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Kyler Murray will not play on Saturday. McCarthy remains the QB2 for Minnesota heading into the season.
items.title: J.J. McCarthy to 'more than likely' start Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Geno Smith will start Friday's preseason game against the Steelers.
items.impact: Smith will see his first action on the field this season. He'll likely only play one or two series.
items.title: Geno Smith to start Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Browns RB Quinshon Judkins was not seen at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Judkins missed practice on Wednesday due to a "minor issue." He remains day-to-day.
items.title: Quinshon Judkins not seen at practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Puka Nacua is not taking part in Thursday's joint practice against the Saints.
items.impact: Nacua is continuing to work his way back from soreness in his groin. He remains day-to-day for now.
items.title: Puka Nacua (groin) not taking part in joint practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Myles Garrett is not participating in Thursday's joint practice against the Saints.
items.impact: Garrett remains hopeful to return to practice next week.
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee) not participating in joint practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: C.J. Stroud is expected to play a few series in Thursday's preseason game against the Las Vegas Raiders.
items.impact: Initial reports suggested that the Texans were going to rest their starters against the Raiders, but now they have made the decision to let some starters play a few series, including Stroud and the team's starters on the offensive line. He will be extremely limited in this game, so there's unlikely to be enough data to draw any fantasy conclusions from this preseason matchup.
items.title: C.J. Stroud expected to play Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Joe Burrow and Cincinnati's starters are set to be sidelined for Saturday's preseason game against the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Burrow and many of Cincinnati's starters played in the team's first preseason game last week, but they are going to be sidelined for this week's game against the Bears. It remains to be seen if their starters will take the field for the team's third and final preseason game on August 28.
items.title: Joe Burrow, Bengals starters set to be sidelined Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jaguars activated OL Cole Van Lanen from the PUP list.
items.impact: Van lanen missed the start of training camp. He has been cleared to return to practice.
items.title: Cole Van Lanen activated from PUP list

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Malik Nabers (knee) is not participating in New York's joint practices with the Miami Dolphins this week.
items.impact: New York has decided to hold Nabers out of their joint practices with the Dolphins this week. He is still recovering from a major knee injury he suffered early last season, and the team wants to be highly cautious with his recovery at this point. Fantasy managers should remain attentive to all updates about his health prior to Week 1 of the regular season.
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) won't participate in joint practices

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Tyler Warren (groin) is set to be sidelined for one week but should be fully healthy in time for Week 1.
items.impact: Warren recently went down what is now being called a groin injury, but it's not a serious issue and he will only miss a week because of it. He is reportedly going to be fully healthy prior to Week 1 of the season, so fantasy managers shouldn't have any hesitations taking him around his ADP in drafts.
items.title: Tyler Warren (groin) set to miss one week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said DE Ashton Gillotte suffered a ruptured plantar fascia in practice.
items.impact: It is a brutal break for Gillotte during training camp.
items.title: Ashton Gillotte suffers ruptured plantar fascia

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Justin Fields is likely to start in Saturday's preseason game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: Fields is expected to be Kansas City's starter again on Saturday in their preseason matchup against the Buccaneers. He isn't expected to be the team's starter heading into the regular season, however, unless there is a setback to the recovery of Patrick Mahomes II.
items.title: Justin Fields likely to start Saturday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Patrick Mahomes II is set to be sidelined for Saturday's preseason game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: To no surprise, the Chiefs will hold Mahomes' out of their second preseason game on Saturday. He is still recovering from a serious knee injury that he suffered late last year, and they don't want to do anything to jeopardize his health before the start of the regular season. Justin Fields is expected to start in his absence.
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II set to be sidelined Saturday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Rachaad White (hamstring) won't play in Saturday's preseason game against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: White is not going to be available to play in Saturday's preseason game. He is still dealing with a minor hamstring injury, but HC Dan Quinn told reporters that he is "certainly close" to a return to the field. Jacory Croskey-Merritt stands to benefit if this injury causes the veteran to miss more time beyond this game.
items.title: Rachaad White (hamstring) won't play Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Broncos signed S Taylor Rapp.
items.impact: Rapp saw plenty of starting time during his tenure in Buffalo. He'll add depth in the secondary for Denver.
items.title: Taylor Rapp signs with Broncos

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Makai Lemon (hamstring) was limited at Philadelphia's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie was able to make his return to practice on Thursday. He was sidelined for a little while after suffering a hamstring injury, but it seems that he is progressing well with his recovery, as the team is now letting him practice in a limited capacity. At this rate he will be ready to play in time for the team's season opener, barring any setbacks with his recovery.
items.title: Makai Lemon (hamstring) limited at practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Luke Altmyer is expected to see equal reps with Joshua Dobbs in Saturday's preseason game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Dobbs will start with Altmyer entering the game behind him as they compete for the backup job behind Jared Goff.
items.title: Luke Altmyer, Joshua Dobbs to see equal reps Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Joshua Dobbs will start Saturday's preseason game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Dobbs and Luke Altmyer will see equal reps as they compete for the backup job.
items.title: Joshua Dobbs to start Saturday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Smith is still in the process of recovering from a hamstring injury, but he was able to take part in Thursday's joint practice with New England in a limited capacity. It seems like his recover is going well, and unless there's a setback of some kind, it looks like he will be fully healthy in time for the season opener.
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) officially limited Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jared Goff will not play in the Lions second preseason game on Saturday against the Commanders.
items.impact: Goff could see some reps in the final preseason game. It will be Josh Dobbs starting with Luke Altmyer seeing reps behind him.
items.title: Jared Goff will not play Saturday

title: Fantasy Player News
